init_gpt_language_model: create a GptLanguageModel instance with a model name and optional OpenAI API key and custom endpoint
sample_text_from_gpt: sample text from a GPT model by passing a prompt string with optional temperature and max tokens
sample_choice_from_gpt: sample a multiple choice response from a GPT model given a prompt and list of candidate responses
configure_gpt_api_base: configure a GptLanguageModel to use a custom OpenAI-compatible API endpoint via the api_base parameter
enable_gpt_measurements: enable usage statistics logging on a GptLanguageModel by passing a measurements object and channel name
